serena.description: LSP-backed symbol navigation and editing (find symbol, references, rename)
serena.install: uv tool install -p 3.13 serena-agent && serena init

codegraphcontext.description: Code graph: call chains, dependencies, who-calls-what (index a repo once with: cgc index .)

ast-grep.description: Structural (syntax-tree) code search for precise refactors
ast-grep.install: uv tool install ast-grep-cli && uv tool install git+https://github.com/ast-grep/ast-grep-mcp

docs.description: Local library documentation index (docs-mcp-server, full-text search, no telemetry)
